items.why: The $97/month HighLevel Certification Program add-on was removed from the add-ons list; other add-on prices are unchanged.

record.short: The $97/month HighLevel Certification Program add-on is no longer listed.

items.why: Enterprise uptime SLA figure rose from 99.9% to 99.99%; a service-level commitment, no price or limit change.
The existing 14-day Business trial is now also shown on the Free and Starter plan cards; prices unchanged.
'3D transforms (Beta)' was added to the Figma Design feature list; no price or plan change.
Enterprise API access is now conditioned on contracts of $5,000+.

record.short: Enterprise API access is now conditioned on contracts of $5,000+.

items.why: Access to Simulators was added to the Starter, Production and Enterprise feature lists; no price change.
Automatic invoice/receipt-to-expense transaction matching, previously Enhanced only, is now also included on Elevate.

record.short: Automatic invoice/receipt-to-expense transaction matching, previously Enhanced only, is now included on Elevate as well.

items.why: Search configurable latency range improved from 450ms-1s to 300ms-1s; a performance spec, no price change.
A limited-time offer (11/13-11/22) of $180 kits plus 3 months of Asset Hub free was added.

promo.text: $180 kits plus 3 months of Asset Hub free, 11/13-11/22

items.why: AI model lineup on Plus and Ultimate was upgraded; prices unchanged.
Pro channel limits (brands, chat widgets, emails, phone and SMS lines) were cut from 5 to 2 and PMS connections from 10 to 5, and the quarterly billing option was removed; plan prices unchanged.

record.short: Pro channel limits (brands, chat widgets, emails, phone and SMS lines) fall from 5 to 2 and PMS connections from 10 to 5; the quarterly billing option is dropped.

items.why: The four packages (AI Agents & Process Mgmt, Document Processing, RPA & Integrations, Enterprise) were replaced by four quote-based plans: IT Team, Agency, Hosted, Sovereign.

record.short: Four packages are replaced by four quote-based plans (IT Team, Agency, Hosted, Sovereign) on annual commitment, with no prices shown.

items.why: Annual prices were cut $10 on each plan: Standard $149 → $139, Premium $199 → $189, Premium Plus $249 → $239.

record.short: Annual prices fall $10 on every plan (Standard $149 → $139, Premium $199 → $189, Premium Plus $249 → $239); the source flags this as matching a known price experiment, so it may be a test.

items.why: Already recorded as e2b-2026w47 (Hobby concurrent sandboxes 20 → 10).
A 'New: Doodle app for iOS & Android' bullet was added to the Free plan feature list; no price or limit change.
Dedicated Relationship Manager and Priority Support bullets were removed from the Enterprise card; these are support services.
FAQ copy changed from 'Dock AI scales with every plan' to 'Dock AI is included in every plan' and the AI usage row was dropped; no numbers or prices changed.
AI features now offer a choice of model and effort level; no price change.
Rate limits switched from requests per minute/second to concurrent threads on all plans (Startup 5/sec → 25 threads, Plus 25/sec → 100 threads).

record.short: Rate limits move from requests per minute/second to concurrent threads: Free 5/min → 1 thread, Startup 5/sec → 25 threads, Plus 25/sec → 100 threads.

items.why: The Teams cap cut from 200 to 100 users is already recorded as cognition-2026w47.
New OCR and Speech APIs were added with launch pricing; no existing price changed.
New promo pricing shown as struck-through 'was' prices on streaming speech-to-text; list rates unchanged.

promo.text: Promo pricing on streaming STT, e.g. Nova-3 Monolingual pay-as-you-go $0.0077 → $0.0048; list rates unchanged

items.why: Personal and Team moved from unlimited AI videos to a single credit balance, and Free sign-up credits fell from 16 to 12; prices unchanged.

record.short: Personal and Team move from unlimited AI videos to a credit balance (Personal 700 credits/month, Team 1,000 shared credits per seat/month) and Free sign-up credits fall 16 → 12.

items.why: Starter (1 user) and Advanced (10 users) now offer Unlimited Users.

record.short: Starter (1 user) and Advanced (10 users) now offer Unlimited Users.

items.why: Free, Analyst ($71) and Team ($199) plans were replaced by a single Business plan at $399/mo annual ($499 monthly) with 1,500 AI credits.

record.short: Free, Analyst ($71) and Team ($199) are replaced by a single Business plan at $399/mo billed annually ($499 monthly).

items.why: Three models were added to Serverless Fine-Tuning pricing; no existing price changed.
Pro rose from $50 to $75/mo, the $150 Team plan was removed and Free hosted words fell from 60K to 40K (Pro words rose 60K to 80K).

record.short: Pro rises $50 → $75/mo, the $150 Team plan is removed and Free hosted words fall 60K → 40K, while Pro words rise 60K → 80K.

items.why: Already recorded as craft-2026w47 (Plus and Family price cuts, shown in CAD there).
The Custom plan no longer lists subsidiary-wide user management among its features.

record.short: The Custom plan no longer lists subsidiary-wide user management among its features.

items.why: A new 20% lifetime discount for verified U.S. Veterans on all subscription plans was added.

promo.text: 20% lifetime discount for verified U.S. Veterans on all plans, no expiration, not combinable with other discounts

items.why: The Fall Flash Sale banner (Codecademy Pro 50% off with FALLFLASH) is gone; card prices unchanged.

promo.text: Fall Flash Sale: 50% off Codecademy Pro with code FALLFLASH has ended

items.why: The Free plan's first 30 days now explicitly include the fixers and the right to run them, not just resource details; the savings summary stays free after 30 days.

record.short: Free plan's first 30 days now include the fixers and the right to run them (before: only full resource details); after 30 days the savings summary stays free.

items.why: The Jaarrekeningen module fell from 2 to 1 credit per entity and the Prognose & budgetten module (€20 per entity) was removed.

record.short: Jaarrekeningen drops from 2 to 1 credit per entity, while the Prognose & budgetten module (€20 per entity) is removed.

items.why: Work Activity Tracking card now shows a 3-year rate 'as low as $7'; the $10 list price is unchanged.
